key_insight: Factorial analysis identified HVOF settings associated with acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide content in Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings provide a starting point for tuning coating quality: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Conducted a reported 24-run full factorial design with spray factors evaluated at two levels.
Measured coating responses and used ANOVA to quantify parameter contributions.
Used Pareto charts to assess interactions among spray parameters.
evidence_signal: Coating responses were measured for each experimental run, but the abstract provides no numerical property values or statistical significance results.
watch_item: Validate the reported settings on the intended equipment before treating them as a transferable process window.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
